title: XPI transmit and receive FIFO storage
note: Each FIFO stores 64 32-bit words. The indirect byte path consumes/produces lanes from these words; the wire lane count and LUT instruction width are separate properties.

title: SPI-SD payload FIFO storage
note: TX entries contain 32 data bits plus four valid-byte strobes; RX entries contain 32 data bits. The diagram shows storage geometry, not a live FIFO occupancy or a card block size.

title: Native SDIO PIO staging storage
note: PIO TX has four entries with a data word and four strobes. RX has one held 32-bit word with separate valid state. Descriptor DMA state is a separate path; FIFO_STATUS is not evidence of an additional undocumented data FIFO.

title: Central DMA per-channel buffering
note: The PRODUCT integration selects eight channels and a 32-word FIFO per channel. The cells illustrate one channel; channels do not share a single software-visible FIFO. A 64-byte descriptor is separate from this payload storage.

title: UART shared FIFO geometry
note: UART0 and UART1 have the same storage geometry; UART1 omits UART0 DMA/RTS/CTS integration. RX metadata is part of each stored entry, distinct from the 32-bit APB read width.

title: I2C command and receive storage
note: Each I2C instance has a 16-entry command FIFO and a separate 16-byte RX FIFO. A command entry is 12 bits, including the byte and READ/RESTART/STOP/NACK controls; it is not a 16-bit payload.

title: WS2812 pixel FIFO storage
note: Sixteen 24-bit GRB entries feed the serializer. Frame length, FIFO occupancy and the reset interval are independent state.

title: I2S audio CDC storage
note: Separate 128-word FIFOs cross system/audio clocks in opposite directions. Full/empty, flush completion and sample packing are separate from physical slot numbering.

title: DVP pixel/event CDC FIFO
note: 128 entries store 32 data bits, four KEEP bits, four STRB bits and two frame/line markers. A partially filled final word retains its valid-lane metadata.

title: USB2 packet stream CDC FIFOs
note: Each direction uses eight entries containing 32 data bits, four strobes and LAST. Work/result mailboxes and packet RAM are separate storage and handshake mechanisms.

title: SDRAM AXI adapter queues
note: Read/write command queues carry address and burst fields; write/read data queues include protocol sidebands. These queue widths are not the external SDRAM DQ width.

title: PS/2 receive and transmit FIFOs
note: RX entries carry eight data bits plus three metadata bits. TX stores eight-bit payloads; start/parity/stop slots are added by the serial engine.

title: PWM per-channel capture FIFO
note: Each instantiated capture channel has a four-entry 32-bit FIFO. Channel count, capture timing and overflow policy remain in the PWM contract; this is not a shared global queue.

title: RNG entropy FIFO
note: Eight words are buffered inside the RNG core. A filled FIFO does not independently establish entropy-source quality; qualification and health-check status still gate use.

title: Crypto streaming FIFO storage
note: Entries carry data and valid-byte/LAST metadata. AES has independent input/output FIFOs; SHA has an input FIFO and separate digest state. Zeroize/abort and ownership rules remain mandatory.

title: APU primitive input/output storage
note: Each FIFO has 64 entries of 41 bits: 32 data bits and nine format/metadata bits. Format presence is separate from production codec delivery and stream-route enablement.

title: QPI read holding register as words
note: One 256-bit read holding register is shown as eight 32-bit word positions. This is a word view, not eight independently queued transactions; the PHY write path is separately 64 bits.

title: OPI optional controller line buffer
note: Four 32-byte data lines have separate tag/valid state. This controller line buffer is distinct from the software-declared 64-byte CPU cache-maintenance granule. Device-range and profile checks still control fills.

title: USB2 packet RAM payload organization
note: The packet-RAM interface addresses 4,096 32-bit payload words (16 KiB). SECDED uses a 39-bit code stored in 40 physical bits; ECC overhead is not additional packet payload capacity. Endpoint/channel regions are software-partitioned and must not overlap.

title: JPEG table-context storage
note: Four logical contexts each contain 1,328 32-bit entries: 256 quantization, 48 DC-table and 1,024 AC-table entries. Context commit/valid state is distinct from table payload and job ownership.

title: APU control-store organization
note: The current loader/fetch address is 11 bits, selecting 2,048 64-bit words (16 KiB). The later 4,096-word / 32 KiB refreeze is not implemented by this snapshot. Instruction memory and local data memory are separate spaces.

title: APU declared local-data address regions
note: Offsets refer to the private local-data space, separate from instruction memory and SoC SRAM. These declared ranges do not advertise enabled KWS, verify physical bank utilization or establish a completed codec image.

title: RSA logical operand/result arrays
note: Each 2,048-bit vector is shown as 64 little-endian 32-bit limb positions. These interfaces represent logical operand state, not secure SRAM, persistent keys or a key-slot service.

title: Worked buffer-budget quantities
note: Cells compare quantities, not adjacent memory regions. Packing overhead can occur within every row or sample, so it is not necessarily one tail-padding region. Odd-width DVP storage is illustrative and is not supported by the current full-word central-DMA path.
